items: 【Sofa Protector】Our couch covers for pets are available in exquisite patterns and various colors. Can be a comfortable couch protector for dogs right on your furniture to guard against scratches, spills, and daily wear and tear.

【Non-Slip Design】The bottom of the sofa cover is equipped with slip resistant silicone particles, which can be firmly attached to the sofa or floor. This non slip sofa cover can prevent shifting and ensure a stable seating experience. So you can focus on enjoying your time.

【Soft and Thick Fabric】Handmade from high-density facecloth fabric, this plush sofa cover is incredibly thick and soft. It's highly shed-resistant, so you can get all the coziness of a fuzzy couch cover without worrying about your furniture and clothes always being covered with shed hairs.

【Easy to Clean】As a completely washable couch covers for pets, maintenance is simple. This sofa covers washable design can be throwed in the washing machine, and its high-quality ensures it emerges without fading or shrinking, ready for use again. Remember to gentle cycle and tumble dry low.

【Perfect Gift for Pet Family】An ideal gift for pet owners, this pet couch cover is both thoughtful and practical. It functions as a dog/cat couch cover, bay window cushion, bedside cushion and rug, or as a soft car seat mat and camping mat when outdoor picnic, offering versatile comfort for every season and every part of your home.
